title: console.log formats Result.Err as Err(value), quoting the nested string payload
notes: Printable category: Result. Not covered by a deka#1116 fixture under tests/dump/pending-console/; derived from crates/pool/src/wintertc.js inspect() -- Result shares the Option/enum `{ __enum, __case, ... }` shape, so Err("boom") formats via the same case-label branch as console_printable_enum/option, and the payload recurses through inspect() rather than formatArgs()'s top-level pass, so the nested string is JSON-quoted (contrast console_printable_string, where a top-level string prints raw).
